results.title: 4 killed, 2 injured in fire at shoe factory in northwest Delhi
results.content: Four people were killed and two others injured after a fire broke out at a shoe factory in Mangolpuri Industrial Area Phase-I in northwest Delhi on Friday night, police said. The Delhi Fire Service rushed 20 fire tenders to the spot after receiving a call at 9.32 p.m. Six people were rescued from inside the factory in an unconscious state and taken to Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital, where four were declared dead. The remaining two are undergoing treatment. Firefighting and rescue operations were underway.

results.title: Whose sight matters? How gender shapes access to eye care in India
results.content: Across their lifespans, from childhood to old age, women face disadvantages in access to eye health and care. For many, treatment depends on how their health is prioritised by the men in their household. Late care, or lack of access can leave girls and women with preventable visual impairment and loss

results.title: Watch: ISRO successfully launches NVS-03 to strengthen India’s navigation capabilities
results.content: ISRO successfully launches the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard the GSLV-F18 rocket from Sriharikota. The 2,250-kg satellite is expected to restore NavIC to its minimum operational configuration of four satellites. With a mission life of 12 years, NVS-03 carries an indigenous atomic clock and adds the L1 signal to the navigation system. The launch marks the GSLV’s 20th mission and its shortest turnaround time of 56 days.

results.title: Watch: Bhutan glacial lake outburst flood damages bridge, roads; Assam on alert
results.content: A glacial lake outburst flood at Shintapu Tsho in Bhutan’s Gasa district has damaged roads, public infrastructure and swept away a Bailey bridge in Punakha. The flood has also raised concerns over a newly formed artificial lake downstream. In India, vulnerable areas in Assam’s Dhubri and Kokrajhar districts have been put on high alert.
